technique_name: Generate a persuasive speech about how space exploration does more harm than good.
description: Space exploration does more harm than good. We waste millions of dollars every year on space exploration. While the potential of these missions is exciting, the cost to our government and taxpayers is simply too high. The money spent on space exploration could instead be used to address more pressing needs such as poverty, hunger and lack of health care and education.
